_comment: Authoritative declaration of CC Director's SHIPPED cc-* tools for the Tools catalog page. This lists ONLY the core tools the installer actually delivers via the Python bundle (mirrors the "ship": true allowlist in tools/registry.json). Each tool gets two universal health checks (binary on PATH, --version responds) plus an optional read-only smoke command declared here. A null smoke means there is no zero-auth read-only command, so the tool is tested presence+version only - shown truthfully in the UI, never faked green. Embedded as a resource in CcDirector.Core so it is available at runtime regardless of working directory. Non-core tools live in the repo (buildable for dev) but are deliberately absent here so they never appear as a phantom NOT BUILT row. cc-browser is core but ships via the Node path (not the Python bundle) and is not health-checked here yet.

tools.name: cc-html
tools.description: Turn plain notes into a styled web page you can share, with a choice of looks.

tools.name: cc-pdf
tools.description: Turn plain notes into a finished PDF you can send, with a choice of looks.

tools.name: cc-word
tools.description: Turn plain notes into a Word document you can edit and send, with a choice of looks.

tools.name: cc-vault
tools.description: A private store on this machine for your contacts and credentials, so an agent can look one up instead of you pasting it into a chat.

tools.name: cc-image
tools.description: Read the text out of a picture, describe what an image shows, and catalogue a whole folder of them.
tools.note: Auth-gated (needs DEVTHROTTLE_API_KEY). No zero-auth command. Presence + version only.

tools.name: cc-gmail
tools.description: Read, search, and send your Gmail from the command line, so an agent can handle email for you.
tools.note: Auth-gated (OAuth). No zero-auth read-only command. Presence + version only.

tools.name: cc-outlook
tools.description: Read, search, and send your Outlook or Microsoft 365 email from the command line.
tools.note: Auth-gated (device code). No zero-auth read-only command. Presence + version only.

tools.name: cc-secrets
tools.description: Passwords your agents can use without ever seeing them: an agent runs a command or signs in to a website with a secret you added by hand, and gets back only the result.

smoke.expectContains: without the model ever seeing it

tools.name: cc-worktrees
tools.description: Worktrees your agent sessions share: one is handed out, given back, and only wiped once its work is proven to be on the remote.

tools.name: cc-devthrottle
tools.description: Run DevThrottle itself from the command line: your sessions, messages between them, schedules, and settings.
